# Your Name

> Software engineer. I build digital products and teams.

This is the personal website and blog of Your Name.

## Writings

Technical writings — add entries here as posts are published.

## Technical Stack

This website is built with:

- **Framework**: Next.js (React)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS
- **Content**: Markdown for blog posts
- **Internationalization**: next-intl
- **Animations**: Framer Motion
- **Language**: TypeScript
